message: I was at a friend’s housewarming party when their smoke alarm decided to join the fun by going off for no reason. My friend, bless their heart, completely panicked, waving their hands like they were directing traffic! I just chuckled and reminded them how important it is to check those alarms regularly and have an escape plan. It’s funny how a little preparedness can turn a moment of chaos into a reminder to stay calm. Do you have a friend who always panics in situations like that?
